questions.question: A certain sum at a certain rate of simple interest becomes ₹ 4,620 after two years and ₹ 4,725 after two and a half years at the same rate. Find the annual percentage rate.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Amount after 2 years (A₁) = ₹4,620

Amount after 2.5 years (A₂) = ₹4,725

Time difference = 0.5 years

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = Principal x Rate x Time / 100

SI for time difference = A₂ - A₁

**Calculations:**

SI = A₂ - A₁ = 4725 - 4620 = 105

SI for 0.5 years = ₹105

SI for 1 year = (105)/(0.5) = 210

Principal = A₁ - SI for 2 years

P = 4620 - 210 times 2 = 4620 - 420 = 4200

Annual rate of interest:

SI = (P times R times T)/(100)

210 = (4200 times R times 1)/(100)

⇒ R = (210 times 100)/(4200) = 5

**∴ The annual percentage rate is 5%.**

questions.question: The average weight of a class of 15 students is 30 kg. A new student joins and the average weight increases by 1 kg. Find the weight (in kg) of the new student.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average weight of a class of 15 students = 30 kg

A new student joins and the average weight increases by 1 kg

**Formula Used:**

Total weight of n students = Average weight × Number of students

**Calculation:**

Total weight of 15 students = 30 × 15

Total weight of 15 students = 450 kg

New average weight = 30 + 1 = 31 kg

Total weight of 16 students = 31 × 16

Total weight of 16 students = 496 kg

Weight of the new student = 496 - 450

Weight of the new student = 46 kg

**The weight of the new student is 46 kg.**

questions.question: Find the least common multiple of 12, 36 and 80.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Numbers are 12, 36, and 80.

**Formula Used:**

 {LCM}(a, b) = (a times b)/({GCD)(a, b)} 

For more than two numbers, LCM is calculated iteratively.

**Calculation:**

First, find the LCM of 12 and 36:

Prime factorization of 12: 2² × 3

Prime factorization of 36: 2² × 3²

LCM of 12 and 36:

⇒ LCM = 2² × 3² = 36

Next, find the LCM of 36 and 80:

Prime factorization of 80: 2⁴ × 5

LCM of 36 and 80:

⇒ LCM = 2⁴ × 3² × 5 = 720

**The least common multiple of 12, 36, and 80 is 720.**

questions.question: A and B together can complete a work in 24 days, while B alone can complete it in 48 days. In how many days can A alone complete this work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A and B together can complete a work in 24 days.

B alone can complete the work in 48 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work done by A and B together in 1 day = 1/24

Work done by B in 1 day = 1/48

Work done by A in 1 day = Work done by A and B together in 1 day - Work done by B in 1 day

**Calculation:**

Work done by A and B together in 1 day = 1/24

Work done by B in 1 day = 1/48

⇒ Work done by A in 1 day = (1/24) - (1/48)

⇒ Work done by A in 1 day = 2/48 - 1/48

⇒ Work done by A in 1 day = 1/48

Time taken by A to complete the work alone = 48 days

**The correct answer is option 1.**

questions.question: If 60% of X = 40% of Y, then find the value of X : Y.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

60% of X = 40% of Y

**Formula Used:**

To find the ratio X : Y

**Calculation:**

60% of X = 40% of Y

⇒ (60/100)X = (40/100)Y

⇒ 60X = 40Y

⇒ X/Y = 40/60

⇒ X/Y = 2/3

**The value of X : Y is 2 : 3.**

questions.question: Shyam sells a notebook for ₹24 with a profit percentage equal to its cost price. What was the purchase price of that notebook for Shyam?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Selling Price (SP) = ₹24

Profit Percentage = Cost Price (CP)

**Formula used:**

Profit Percentage = frac{{Profit}}{{CP}} × 100

Profit = SP - CP

**Calculations:**

Let CP = x

Profit Percentage = CP = x

frac{{SP - CP}}{{CP}} × 100 = x

⇒ (24 - x)/(x) × 100 = x

⇒ (24 - x)/(x) = (x)/(100)

⇒ (24 - x) × 100 = x × x

⇒ 2400 - 100x = x²

⇒ x² + 100x - 2400 = 0

After factorization

⇒ x2 - 20x + 120x - 2400 = 0

(x – 20) (x + 120) = 0

x = 20 and -120

Since CP cannot be negative So, CP = 20

**∴ The purchase price of the notebook is ₹20.**

questions.question: Akash and Vikas start walking towards each other at the same time from two places located 88 km apart and meet each other after 8 hours. If Akash travels at (7)/(6) times his speed and Vikas travels at 3 times his speed, they meet after 4 hours. What is the path of development?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance between two places = 88 km

Time to meet (first case) = 8 hours

Akash's speed = a

Vikas's speed = v

In second case:

Akash's speed = (7)/(6)a

Vikas's speed = 3v

Time to meet (second case) = 4 hours

**Formula used:**

Total Distance = Relative Speed × Time

**Calculations:**

In the first case:

(a + v) times 8 = 88

⇒ (a + v) = (88)/(8) = 11

In the second case:

((7)/(6)a + 3v) times 4 = 88

⇒ ((7)/(6)a + 3v) = (88)/(4) = 22

Substituting a + v = 11 into the second equation:

⇒ (7)/(6)a + 3(11 - a) = 22

⇒ (7)/(6)a + 33 - 3a = 22

⇒ -(11)/(6)a + 33 = 22

⇒ -(11)/(6)a = 22 - 33 = -11

⇒ a = (6 times 11)/(11) = 6

Substitute a = 6 into a + v = 11:

⇒ 6 + v = 11

⇒ v = 5

**∴ Akash's speed = 6 km/h, Vikas's speed = 5 km/h.**

questions.question: A hollow spherical vessel has external and internal radii of 10.5 cm and 7.7 cm respectively. What is the mass (in kg, rounded off to the nearest tens) of the sphere if it is made of metal of density 10.3 g/cm³? (Take π = 22/7)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

External radius (Rₑₓₜ) = 10.5 cm

Internal radius (Rᵢₙₜ) = 7.7 cm

Density of the metal (ρ) = 10.3 g/cm³

π = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a sphere = (4)/(3) pi r³ 

Volume of the hollow sphere = Volume of external sphere - Volume of internal sphere

Mass = Density × Volume

**Calculation:**

Volume of external sphere (Vₑₓₜ)

⇒ Vₑₓₜ = (4)/(3) pi (10.5)³

⇒ Vₑₓₜ = (4)/(3) times (22)/(7) times 1157.625 

⇒ Vₑₓₜ = 4852.5 cm³

Volume of internal sphere (Vᵢₙₜ)

⇒ Vᵢₙₜ = (4)/(3) pi (7.7)³

⇒ Vᵢₙₜ = (4)/(3) times (22)/(7) times 456.533 

⇒ Vᵢₙₜ = 1980 cm³

Volume of the hollow sphere (V)

⇒ V = Vₑₓₜ - Vᵢₙₜ

⇒ V = 4852.5 - 1980

⇒ V = 2872.5 cm³

Mass (m)

⇒ m = ρ × V

⇒ m = 10.3 × 2872.5

⇒ m = 29587.75 g

Convert g to kg

⇒ m = 29587.75 / 1000

⇒ m ≈ 29.6 kg

Rounded off to the nearest tens, mass = 30 kg

**The mass of the sphere is 30 kg.**

questions.question: Find HCF of 620 and 248.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Numbers to find HCF of: 620 and 248.

**Formula Used:**

Euclidean Algorithm: HCF(a, b) = HCF(b, a mod b)

**Calculation:**

Step 1: Apply Euclidean Algorithm:

⇒ 620 mod 248 = 124

Step 2: Apply Euclidean Algorithm again:

⇒ 248 mod 124 = 0

**The HCF of 620 and 248 is 124.**

questions.question: The area of the base of a right circular cone is 25π cm² and its height is 12 cm. What is the curved surface area (in cm2) of the cone?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Area of the base of the cone = 25π cm²

Height of the cone = 12 cm

**Formula Used:**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a cone = π × r × l

where r = radius of the base, l = slant height

Slant height, l = √(r² + h²)

**Calculation:**

Area of the base = π × r² = 25π

⇒ r² = 25

⇒ r = √25

⇒ r = 5 cm

Slant height, l = √(r² + h²)

⇒ l = √(5² + 12²)

⇒ l = √(25 + 144)

⇒ l = √169

⇒ l = 13 cm

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = π × r × l

⇒ CSA = π × 5 × 13

⇒ CSA = 65π cm²

**The curved surface area of the cone is 65π cm².**

questions.question: A seller offers a trade discount of 10% and 20% on the purchase of an article whose marked price is ₹500. Another seller gives 30% discount on the same item. What is the difference between their selling prices (in ₹)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marked price = ₹500

First seller's discounts = 10% and 20%

Second seller's discount = 30%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price = Marked Price - Discount

**Calculation:**

**First Seller's Calculation:**

First discount: 10% of ₹500

⇒ 10% × ₹500 = ₹50

Price after first discount: ₹500 - ₹50

⇒ ₹450

Second discount: 20% of ₹450

⇒ 20% × ₹450 = ₹90

Selling price after second discount: ₹450 - ₹90

⇒ ₹360

**Second Seller's Calculation:**

30% discount on ₹500

⇒ 30% × ₹500 = ₹150

Selling price after 30% discount: ₹500 - ₹150

⇒ ₹350

**Difference between their selling prices:**

⇒ ₹360 - ₹350

⇒ ₹10

**The difference between their selling prices is ₹10.**
